## Objetivo
Deliver play entry using T05's APIs, history and leaderboard views using T14's derived APIs, and live updates using T15's shared client lifecycle and T10's controls. Keep transactional routes in T05 and derived server reads/publication in T14. T06 owns full cross-feature journeys; T09 owns final visual/accessibility thresholds.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] Client forms support game/date selection, distinct participants, optional scores and explicit single or joint winners, including a confirmed-night mode constrained to that night's date and attendee snapshot. Fast unit tests cover payload construction and form validation for missing winners, winners outside participants and optional/negative/zero scores. Validation preserves entered values and gives a clear next step.
- [ ] Playwright through run_browser_tests at 1280x720 and 390x844 records scored and scoreless plays, including joint winners, and asserts updated global/per-game totals and game history without a hard reload. Labels and textual winner markers do not depend on color alone. Empty history/leaderboard and failed-save states have actionable guidance.
- [ ] Extend T15's fast client tests to verify play invalidations refetch mounted play/history, global/per-game leaderboard and affected suggestion data. A two-session browser scenario records a play in one context and asserts the second context's visible leaderboard/history updates through SSE without navigation or reload. A prior-night linked play similarly updates an already visible later-night suggestion list. Synchronize on subscription readiness and visible conditions, never fixed sleeps.
- [ ] Browser tests reuse diagnostics helpers and include pageerror/console.error in failure messages. Capture viewport-only filled-form, visible invalid-winner error, saved-history and updated-leaderboard screenshots at both viewports after scrolling the relevant element into view. Controls remain labeled and score entry is not clipped. npm test, npm run typecheck, npm run build and npm test && npm run test:e2e pass.
